title: Why Counting Sheep Does NOT Help You Sleep
hook: Does counting sheep actually help you fall asleep?

narration.text: The classic advice to count sheep for sleep is actually counterproductive.
Your brain needs to relax and quiet down before it can drift off.
Counting sheep, however, is a repetitive, active mental task.
This mental effort keeps your mind engaged and alert, not sleepy.
It can actually make it harder to switch off and enter a restful state.
Instead, try focusing on slow, deep breathing or gentle muscle relaxation.
These techniques encourage your body and mind to calm down naturally.
What do you do to help yourself fall asleep?

description: Counting sheep is a well-known sleep remedy, but it might actually be keeping you awake. We explore why this popular technique doesn't work and what you can do instead to encourage restful sleep.
